risk_note: RV2 (content pages + platform queue; page scheduled publish, orchestrator D8 / Y-defaults, P5 / P6 / P9 / P12 in 01 F-HOME-07; contract CT-02y #1076, migration F1-09n #1092, queue test-change F1-09q #1082). Publishing with publish_at writes the pending slot (after now, within 30 days; a pending slot rejects another publish), audits page_publish_schedule and enqueues content.page_schedule_due on the page-schedule queue in the same transaction; reads judge the slot by the injected Clock (due at scheduled_at inclusive) so the page switches without waiting for the job; every page write first materialises a due slot under the row lock (transition via pageVersionChange, publisher / publish_at = scheduler / scheduled_at, revision +1, no audit row) before the CAS; the job locks the row and materialises, re-enqueues when early, or does nothing when the slot is gone (idempotent at least once). DELETE /admin/v1/pages/{page_key}/schedule loses its planned mark: materialise, CAS, 30701 without a slot, audit page_schedule_cancel. Code review round 1 found that a draft cached before materialisation could make the public read 404 until the cache expired; fixed by treating a cached draft referenced by the pointer as stale. Test-machine full verify passed. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
